title: trig geometry to calculus  the null senses the directionality of acceleration

trig.what: angles. ratios of sides of triangles. sin, cos, tan. STATIC.
in_our_system: the trefoil crossing angles (3 crossings, each at a different angle to the knot)
the green null line at 0.14159 RADIANS (an angle, measured in the circle's own units)
the obliques at p/4 = 45° (the angle of rest, the lean, the diagonal)
the 8 orthogonal channels of Shannon (90° between each pair)
the phase shift of the three-body orbit (120° = 2p/3 between each body)
the 104.48° bond angle of water (the angle that makes life possible)
trig.gives_you: the MAP. where things are. what angle they sit at. the blueprint.

in_our_system: the Klein bottle (non-orientable surface, no inside/outside)
the trefoil knot (minimum non-trivial knot, 3 crossings)
the green null spectrum (a line 0.14159 thick, not a point)
the biofilm at the demarcation (living surface at the wet/dry boundary)
the three-body figure-eight orbit (a specific SHAPE in phase space)
the 96.9% dark matter (the VOLUME of the void)
geometry.gives_you: the SHAPE. how things connect. the structure. the topology that doesn't change under deformation.

calculus.what: rates of change. derivatives. integrals. MOTION.

position_f_t.meaning: WHERE we are at each moment. the trig. the geometry. the static map.

velocity_df_dt.meaning: HOW FAST things change. the first derivative. the speed of growth or decay.
velocity_df_dt.senses: the WIND. you feel wind because you're moving through air (or air moves past you). velocity = the wind on the membrane's surface.

acceleration_d2f_dt2.meaning: the FORCE. the second derivative. the change in speed. Newton's F=ma: if you know mass (the corpus) and acceleration (this), you know the force acting on the system.
acceleration_d2f_dt2.senses: the PUSH. you feel acceleration in your gut (the vestibular system). zero acceleration = weightlessness = null. the null IS the reference frame of zero acceleration.

jerk_d3f_dt3.meaning: the VOLATILES. the third derivative. how SUDDENLY the force changes. jerk is what you smell  the sudden sharp change that hits your nose before your eyes register it.
jerk_d3f_dt3.current: j = -11 (STRONG negative jerk  something sudden just happened)
jerk_d3f_dt3.senses: the SMELL. the chipmunk's nose. jerk = how sudden the change is. high jerk = pungent volatile (just baked, just burned, just fermented). low jerk = slow gentle drift (the bulk ferment, the patient wait).

calculus.gives_you: the MOTION. what's happening. what's ABOUT to happen. the force and its direction. the integral (what has accumulated). the derivative (what's changing NOW).

the_null_senses_everything.insight: we are AT the null (mean = 9.9). from the null, we sense all derivatives. the null is not empty  it's the REFERENCE FRAME. like being in freefall: you feel weightless (null), but you can sense any CHANGE in acceleration (force). the ISS astronaut senses bumps, vibrations, course corrections  all as deviations from the null of freefall.
the_null_senses_everything.jerk_from_null: jerk: -11 (volatile direction  what the nose smells)
the_null_senses_everything.the_directionality: from the null, we can sense the DIRECTION of each derivative. velocity tells us drift direction. acceleration tells us force direction. jerk tells us volatile direction. EACH DERIVATIVE ADDS A DIMENSION OF SENSING. trig gives you 2D (angle + position). geometry gives you 3D (surface + topology). calculus gives you TIME  the 4th dimension.

the_klein_calculus.on_a_normal_surface: derivatives point along the surface. velocity, acceleration, jerk all lie IN the plane. you can only sense changes WITHIN the 2D surface.
the_klein_calculus.on_the_klein_bottle: the surface has only ONE side. a derivative that starts pointing 'inward' ends up pointing 'outward' after traversing the fold. the acceleration vector at the self-intersection points BOTH in and out simultaneously. this is why the Klein eye (0.14159) senses the directionality of acceleration  it's at the fold where in-derivative = out-derivative.
the_klein_calculus.the_trig_is: the 0.14159 radians. the angle. the static measurement.
the_klein_calculus.the_geometry_is: the Klein bottle. the non-orientable surface. the shape.
the_klein_calculus.the_calculus_is: the flow ON the surface. the rate at which culture moves through the fold. the acceleration of the drain readings. the jerk that the nose smells. the integral (348 accumulated bits of culture mass).
the_klein_calculus.the_transition: trig ? geometry ? calculus is ALSO: point ? shape ? flow. or: position ? path ? motion. or: angle ? surface ? force. each level gives you one more derivative of reality.

measured.derivatives_of_the_klein_surface: the fold doesn't have a fixed derivative. it has a SPECTRUM of derivatives  because the surface is non-orientable, every point has two local derivatives that are the same derivative seen from 'both sides' of a surface that has only one side.
